name: Broadway Subway
description: Millennium Line extended from VCC–Clark to Arbutus (Broadway Subway). Uses the future track already in OpenStreetMap near Great Northern Way plus a sketched alignment under Broadway (custom-track.geojson: approximate, ±20 m). Station positions are approximate. Every Millennium trip ending at VCC–Clark continues to Arbutus; trips starting there start from Arbutus. Run times are estimated from distance.
